headline: ‘Confessions II’ Review: Madonna Returns to the Dance Floor
context: On “Confessions II,” a successor to her hit 2005 album “Confessions on a Dance Floor,” the pop superstar gives new energy to her origin story and shines light on the troubles she’s danced away.
